title: Modular Hardening & Navigation Freedom
changes: UI Standardization: Unified the top bar across all service views (Dockge, Glances, Uptime Kuma, Home Assistant, and Media Engine) with a premium 64px header and consistent typography.
Navigation Reordering: Implemented manual reordering for sidebar links with Up/Down controls in Settings, giving users full control over their navigation hierarchy.
Header Consistency: Standardized titles (15px bold) and subtitles (11px semi-transparent) across the entire application to ensure a cohesive, professional UX.
Modular Visibility Hardening: Enforced strict opt-in registration for native modules and implemented hidden manifest flags for internal development components.
Iframe Guard System: Enhanced the layout engine to correctly identify and render native pages (including Media Engine) without redundant iframe wrappers.
Refined Interaction: Finalized the icon-only 'Back' button standard across all service pages, eliminating residual text labels for a cleaner interface.

title: Open Source Release & Security Hardening
changes: Official Open Source release with MIT License and public documentation.
Resolved critical Next.js ChunkLoadError by stabilizing the Turbopack build pipeline.
Comprehensive TypeScript hardening: Fixed manifest property mismatches and AppSettings type integrity.
Comprehensive security hardening for API routes including Host header validation.
Unified Plex TLS handling with support for user-defined certificate validation preferences.
Implemented request cancellation (AbortController) to prevent memory leaks and race conditions.
Added 'hasChanges' confirmation prompts to settings to prevent accidental data loss.
Enhanced Module Settings dialog with ARIA accessibility roles and keyboard navigation.
Added dynamic geocoding for keyless Open-Meteo weather integration.
Optimized global CSS system with unified elevation levels and pulse animations.
Refined Radarr/Sonarr views with robust defensive coding for numeric edge cases.

title: Modernized Plex Discovery & UI Refinement
changes: Overhauled Plex server name fetching logic to prioritize user-defined 'friendlyName' over machine GUIDs.
Refactored Weather Widget with dynamic contrast engine for perfect legibility in Light Mode.
Synchronized global design system with MD3 semantic tokens, eliminating legacy 'dark-mode islands'.
Added centralized 'About & System' section in settings with release notes and changelog history.
Implemented strict XSS sanitization for dynamic text labels while allowing human-readable titles.
Optimized Plex terminal page with high-contrast status chips and infrastructure branding.
Streamlined widget headers by removing redundant status labels for a more premium look.

title: Material 3 Stability & Glassmorphism
changes: Implemented Material Design 3 (MD3) surface color system across all dashboard widgets.
Introduced 'Glass' theme variant with theme-aware frosted opacities.
Added Plex SSO (OAuth) support for secure, one-click server discovery.
Improved dashboard grid stability and mobile layout responsiveness.
Enhanced sidebar navigation with searchable service gallery and custom icons.

title: Initial Launch: Horizon Core
changes: Initial release of the Horizon Personal Dashboard.
Support for Loopia DNS, Cloudflare, Plex, Immich, and Home Assistant monitoring.
Customizable grid layout with drag-and-drop support.
Global search functionality for settings and navigation.
Dark and Light mode support with system theme syncing.
